integrity_note: The exact universal phase diagram is proved algebraically; finite exact-arithmetic tests are supplementary and independent historical audit has not occurred.
limitations: Exactly three equal-size patches on a line with symmetric nearest-neighbour adult movement and absorbing external boundaries.
Recruitment is an externally imposed constant inflow at the first patch only; mortality and harvest are linear.
Exactly one fully protected patch is mandatory; all other patches are fished with identical constant per-capita rate.
No costs, nonlinear growth, stochasticity, multi-species interactions, additional reserve choices or empirical calibration.
Historical originality is provisional; a highly relevant earlier article was available only as an abstract.
title: Every location of a one-patch marine reserve is optimal in its own conservation-weight interval
